Use `snl entry latex` to inspect the authoritative bare-LaTeX rendering of one Entry.

### Agent procedure
1. Get the Entry first when title, package, or revision context matters.
2. Use the rendering as a diagnostic or export input; do not treat it as an editable replacement for the Entry SNL tree.

### Machine-use contract
Invoke `snl entry latex` with an explicit `--root` and `--json`. Treat returned IDs and revisions as opaque. Branch on the structured status and exit code; do not scrape human-formatted output or edit `.SNL_Doc` files directly.
